Take the oriote raven feather from the oriote ravens on the hill south of the entrance to Neriak.
Bring the lantern of ages, the gem of fury and the oriote raven feather to Zelthil J`Narus.
steps.says: Now give the lamp to Lady Furess.

steps.journal: Bring the enchanted lantern of ages to Lady Furess U`Dedne.
steps.says: A gift from Zelthil? How thoughtful.

steps.journal: Return to Zelthil J'Narus.
steps.says: She has it. Good.

steps.journal: Return to Sorceress X`Lottl.
steps.says: You have done well.

quests.notes: From EQOA-Data Quests/1-20/neriak-nektulos/wizard.json, # Level 15 (github.com/Jadiction/EQOA-Data, MIT). The waysender and dockmaster trips are the player's own (their usual menus); the steps are the people at either end. Zelthil and Zethil are one man in the guides. The guide names no reward but the experience; the experience is the one every city gives for this level. The reward is ours: the Shocking Gaze scroll, as Freeport's, Highbourne's, Klick'Anon's and Qeynos's quests of this level teach it (tools/fill_class_quest_rewards.py, 2026-10-30).

quests.name: Zelthil's Errand
quests.offer: Zelthil J'Narus needs your services again. Go to him.
quests.declined: Then go. Come back when you are ready.
quests.started: Go, then, and do not keep me waiting.

steps.journal: Speak with Zelthil J`Narus.
steps.says: Quartermaster T'Nak in Fort Seriak has work for you.

steps.journal: Bring 1000 tunar to Quartermaster T`Nak.
steps.says: A thousand tunar, and Courier B'Malin dies on the River Saren.

steps.journal: Take the courier's satchel from Courier B'Malin along the River Saren.
Bring the courier's satchel to Zelthil J`Narus.
steps.says: Now the two groundskeepers, at Castle Felstar and in the Tomb of Elders.

steps.journal: Take the femur bone from Groundskeeper F'Redai at Castle Felstar.
Take the finger bone from Groundskeeper W'Lai in the Tomb of Elders.
Bring the femur bone and the finger bone to Zelthil J`Narus.
steps.says: Both. Go back to your master.

steps.journal: Return to Sorceress X`Lottl.
steps.says: It is done. Choose your path.
